about: Free study and growth material published by Cru (cru.org). Nothing of Cru's is copied into this app: each entry is a title, a line written here to say what it is, and a link that opens it on cru.org, where Cru's own read-online and download buttons are. The summaries are ours; the material, and its copyright, are Cru's.

todaysPromise.title: Today's Promise
todaysPromise.line: A verse to hold, a short passage to read, and one thing to do today — a few minutes from Cru's daily devotional.

items.title: The Community
items.summary: Cru's small-group curriculum: over a hundred studies that start with the basics of faith and build from there. Free to download.

items.title: The Holy Spirit — a five-part study
items.summary: Who the Holy Spirit is, what walking in the Spirit looks like, and how he helps you walk with God. Written for groups.

items.title: Jesus: an investigative study
items.summary: A study that looks at who Jesus is from the Gospels — suited to a group with a friend who is still asking.

items.title: Every study to read online or download
items.summary: Cru's full list of free studies, by topic and by book of the Bible.

items.title: Group studies by book of the Bible
items.summary: Pick the book your group is reading and find a study written for it.

items.title: Group studies by topic
items.summary: Studies grouped by subject — prayer, identity, relationships and more.

items.title: Transferable Concepts
items.summary: Bill Bright's short teachings on the essentials — assurance, the Spirit, prayer, sharing your faith. Made to be passed on.

items.title: How you can be filled with the Holy Spirit
items.summary: One of the Transferable Concepts, including the idea of "spiritual breathing".

items.title: Holy Spirit resource kit
items.summary: Cru's collected material on the Holy Spirit in one place.

items.title: The Christian and the Holy Spirit
items.summary: Step three of Cru's Ten Basic Steps toward Christian maturity.

items.title: Theology Central
items.summary: Plain explanations of what Christians believe, and why.

items.title: How to have a daily time with God
items.summary: A practical guide to a quiet time that is about meeting God rather than ticking a box.

items.title: How to study the Bible on your own
items.summary: A simple method for reading a passage closely without a group or a commentary.

items.title: Passages — a daily devotional on sharing your faith
items.summary: Short daily readings, prayer and reflection on talking about Jesus with the people you already know.

items.title: Knowing God Personally (booklet)
items.summary: The booklet that explains how to begin a relationship with God, step by step. A PDF you can keep on your phone.

items.title: Short training videos
items.summary: Cru's library of brief videos on leading, sharing your faith and discipleship.
